The '''Prehistoric Tibia''' is an [[Artifacts|Artifact]] that can be found from:
* Digging up an [[Artifact Spot]] at the [[Railroad]] or in [[Cindersap Forest]].
* Dropped by a [[Pepper Rex]] (30%).
* Breaking [[Mining#Bone Node|Bone Nodes]] on the [[Ginger Island]] Dig Site.
* Gifted by a [[Animals#Pets|pet]] dog with max [[Animals#Friendship|friendship]].

==Donation==
Donation of this item contributes to the total count of donations for the [[Museum]].

Donating this item, along with the [[Skeletal Tail]], will reward the player with the [[Sloth Skeleton|Sloth Skeleton R]] statue.

==Bone Mill==
The Prehistoric Tibia can be turned into [[Quality Fertilizer]], [[Speed-Gro]], [[Deluxe Speed-Gro]] or [[Tree Fertilizer]] in the [[Bone Mill]].

==Bundles==
The Prehistoric Tibia is not used in any [[bundles]].

==Tailoring==
The Prehistoric Tibia is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the {{Name|Hair Bone|class=inline}}.

==Quests==
*[[Quests#Fragments of the past|"Fragments of the past"]]: [[Gunther]] may make a request on the [[Quests#List of Special Orders|Special Orders board]] for 100 of any combination of bone items that must be gathered while the quest is active. You have 7 days to complete the quest. The reward is {{Price|3500}} and the [[Bone Mill]] recipe.
